[Resource from qmd at qmd://prisma/apps/docs/content/docs/orm/v7/prisma-client/special-fields-and-types/composite-types.mdx] 1: ---
2: title: Composite types
3: description: Work with composite types and embedded documents in MongoDB
4: url: /orm/v7/prisma-client/special-fields-and-types/composite-types
5: metaTitle: Composite types
6: metaDescription: Composite types
7: ---
8: 
9: :::warning
10: 
11: Composite types are only available with MongoDB.
12: 
13: :::
14: 
15: [Composite types](/orm/v7/prisma-schema/data-model/models), known as [embedded documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/data-modeling/#embedded-data) in MongoDB, allow you to embed records within other records.
16: 
17: This page explains how to:
18: 
19: - [find](#finding-records-that-contain-composite-types-with-find-and-findmany) records that contain composite types using `findFirst` and `findMany`
20: - [create](#creating-records-with-composite-types-using-create-and-createmany) new records with composite types using `create` and `createMany`
21: - [update](#changing-composite-types-within-update-and-updatemany) composite types within existing records using `update` and `updateMany`
22: - [delete](#deleting-records-that-contain-composite-types-with-delete-and-deletemany) records with composite types using `delete` and `deleteMany`
23: 
24: ## Example schema
25: 
26: We’ll use this schema for the examples that follow:
27: 
28: ```prisma title="schema.prisma" showLineNumbers
29: generator client {
30:   provider = "prisma-client-js"
31: }
32: 
33: datasource db {
34:   provider = "mongodb"
35:   url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
36: }
37: 
38: model Product {
39:   id     String  @id @default(auto()) @map("_id") @db.ObjectId
40:   name   String  @unique
41:   price  Float
42:   colors Color[]
43:   sizes  Size[]
44:   photos Photo[]
45:   orders Order[]
46: }
47: 
48: model Order {
49:   id              String   @id @default(auto()) @map("_id") @db.ObjectId
50:   product         Product  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id])
51:   color           Color
52:   size            Size
53:   shippingAddress Address
54:   billingAddress  Address?
55:   productId       String   @db.ObjectId
56: }
57: 
58: enum Color {
59:   Red
60:   Green
61:   Blue
62: }
63: 
64: enum Size {
65:   Small
66:   Medium
67:   Large
68:   XLarge
69: }
70: 
71: type Photo {
72:   height Int    @default(200)
73:   width  Int    @default(100)
74:   url    String
75: }
76: 
77: type Address {
78:   street String
79:   city   String
80:   zip    String
